title: 泰勒·斯威夫特税百万度假屋中产税单涨50%？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Greg, good to have you on the program. This is a most read story on the Bloomberg terminal and for very good reason.
segments.zh: 格雷格，欢迎来到节目。这是彭博终端上阅读量最高的故事，原因很充分。

segments.en: It's not just the headline that is amazing. The entire story is amazing.
segments.zh: 不仅标题惊人，整个故事都令人惊叹。

segments.en: Taylor Swift-Taxters, bad blood with Rhode Island homeowners.
segments.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特税，与罗德岛房主关系紧张。

segments.en: What is the so-called Taylor Swift-Tax? So the tax is an annual property tax on second homes
segments.zh: 所谓的泰勒·斯威夫特税是什么？这是罗德岛对价值超过100万美元的第二套住房征收的年度房产税。

segments.en: in Rhode Island that are valued over $1 million. It's half a percentage point.
And it was past last year as part of the state budget. The purpose is to raise money to build more affordable housing in Rhode Island.
segments.zh: 去年作为州预算的一部分通过，目的是筹集资金在罗德岛建造更多经济适用房。

segments.en: It seems like a relatively small amount. And the reason I bring that up is just for the Taylor Swift example.
segments.zh: 这看起来金额相对较小，我提到这一点是因为泰勒·斯威夫特的例子。

segments.en: She has a 12,700 square foot mansion.
segments.zh: 她拥有一栋12700平方英尺的豪宅。

segments.en: So that means an extra tax bill of about $136,000.
segments.zh: 这意味着额外税单约13.6万美元。

segments.en: That's not that much for her, given the value of the home.
segments.zh: 对她来说，考虑到房产价值，这不算多。

segments.en: How is it affecting those people at the lower end of the income and fame spectrum?
segments.zh: 这对那些收入和名气较低的人有何影响？

segments.en: Yeah, it's interesting. I mean, the lattice protests here are not coming from those who own mega mansions next to Taylor's and in Watch Hill.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，抗议并非来自泰勒豪宅的邻居，

segments.en: It's really coming from these homeowners who've had modest properties, modification homes in their family for generations, often three or four generations,
segments.zh: 而是来自那些世代拥有普通房产的家庭，

segments.en: who are going to be seeing their tax bills going up by 50% or more with this Taylor Swift tax.
segments.zh: 他们的房产税将因这项税收上涨50%以上。
